types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.AssetIds
types.doc: AssetIds identifies the asset roles involved in one lifecycle.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Zipped asset identifier for the chain-specific asset mapping row. This is
 the canonical id from `chain_zipped_assets`, which already represents the
 source-chain asset metadata plus its mapped zToken relationship when
 relevant.

fields.name: unified_asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset identifier for the uAsset used by funding or trading flows
 when relevant. This is the canonical Polyester asset identity used by
 FundingAccount, TradingGateway, Lending, and other downstream product
 domains.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowDetailView
types.doc: FlowDetailView is the full lifecycle detail response model.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: Compact flow summary for headers and list-style display.

fields.name: observed_steps
fields.doc:
Factual visible steps observed for this flow, ordered by sequence. Open
 flows may have `summary.current_step` ahead of the last observed step.

fields.name: from_live_state
fields.doc:
True when this detail was served from live in-memory state rather than
 historical terminal state.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowDomain
types.doc:
FlowDomain identifies the product domain that currently owns or processes the
 value represented by the lifecycle.

values.name: DOMAIN_EXTERNAL_CHAIN
values.doc: Value still belongs to an external chain outside Polyester.

values.name: DOMAIN_ZIPPER
values.doc: Value is inside the Zipper layer on Polyester Chain.

values.name: DOMAIN_FUNDING
values.doc: Value is inside FundingAccount.

values.name: DOMAIN_TRADING
values.doc: Value is inside TradingGateway or the trading domain.

values.name: DOMAIN_LENDING
values.doc: Value is inside the lending domain or pool.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowKind
types.doc: FlowKind identifies the product flow family.

values.name: KIND_DEPOSIT
values.doc: Deposit flow into Polyester-controlled assets or accounts.

values.name: KIND_WITHDRAW
values.doc: Withdraw flow out of Polyester-controlled assets or accounts.

values.name: KIND_TRANSFER
values.doc: Internal transfer flow between Polyester-controlled accounts.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowReason
types.doc:
FlowReason is the stable product-facing reason catalog for failed, dropped,
 refunded, or otherwise notable lifecycle states.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_ZIPPER_VALIDATION_REJECTED
values.doc: Zipper validators reached the rejection quorum.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_ZIPPER_EXECUTION_REJECTED
values.doc: Zipper execution rejected the request.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_ZIPPER_WITHDRAW_EXECUTION_FAILED
values.doc: Zipper withdraw execution failed.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_ZIPPER_DEPOSIT_REFUND_FAILED
values.doc: Zipper deposit refund failed.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_LEDGER_MIRROR_REJECTED
values.doc: Ledger mirror rejected a command before it could be durably applied.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_LEDGER_MIRROR_TRANSFER_EXCEEDS_CREDITS
values.doc:
Ledger settlement rejected the mirror command because the source account did
 not have enough credits for the transfer.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_LEDGER_MIRROR_TRANSFER_EXISTS
values.doc:
Ledger settlement reported that the transfer already exists for this mirror
 command identity.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_LEDGER_MIRROR_PENDING_TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
Ledger settlement reported that the pending transfer referenced by the
 command was not found.

values.name: FLOW_REASON_LEDGER_MIRROR_TRANSFER_ID_ALREADY_FAILED
values.doc: Ledger settlement reported that this transfer id is already marked failed.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowState
types.doc: FlowState is the latest lifecycle state after folding normalized facts.

values.name: STATE_PENDING_SOURCE
values.doc: Flow exists and is still waiting on source-chain progress.

values.name: STATE_PENDING_POLYESTER_CHAIN
values.doc: Flow is now progressing on Polyester Chain after source readiness.

values.name: STATE_PENDING_LEDGER
values.doc: Flow is now waiting for an off-chain ledger effect or settlement effect.

values.name: STATE_COMPLETED
values.doc: Flow completed successfully.

values.name: STATE_FAILED
values.doc: Flow failed and is no longer progressing.

values.name: STATE_DROPPED
values.doc: Flow was dropped before successful completion.

values.name: STATE_REFUNDED
values.doc: Flow ended in a refund or reversal.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowStep
types.doc:
FlowStep is the public lifecycle step shown in API and realtime read
 models. It is business-facing and intentionally hides the lower-level
 technical milestone taxonomy.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_SOURCE
values.doc: External-chain / relayer source tracking before Polyester can continue.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_TRANSFER
values.doc: Deposit-side mint and downstream crediting / transfer stage.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_REQUEST
values.doc: Polyester request creation stage.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_VALIDATION
values.doc: Polyester validation / quorum stage.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_EXECUTION
values.doc: Polyester execution stage.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_BRIDGE_FULFILLMENT
values.doc: Bridge fulfillment before final ledger settlement.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_DROPPED
values.doc: Flow was dropped before success.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_FAILED
values.doc: Flow failed in a user-visible way.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_REFUNDED
values.doc: Flow reached a refund or reversal result.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_FULFILLING
values.doc:
Withdraw destination tx hash was committed and the flow is waiting for the
 final fulfillment confirmation.

values.name: FLOW_STEP_SETTLEMENT
values.doc: Off-chain ledger settlement was durably confirmed.

values.name: ACTIVITY_MINTED
values.doc: Mapped asset was minted on Polyester Chain.

values.name: ACTIVITY_FUNDING
values.doc: Funding account received the credit.

values.name: ACTIVITY_TRADING
values.doc: Trading account received the credit.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowStepActivityView
types.doc: FlowStepActivityView is an expandable detail row underneath a visible step.

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: Sequence of the underlying activity within the flow.

fields.name: tx_ref
fields.doc: Transaction reference associated with this activity.

fields.name: occurred_at_unix_ms
fields.doc: Activity occurrence timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: lifecycle_source
fields.doc: Source that produced this activity.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.doc: Product-facing reason for notable activity states.

fields.name: current_confirmations
fields.doc: Current source confirmation count when confirmations apply.

fields.name: required_confirmations
fields.doc: Required source confirmation count when confirmations apply.

fields.name: approve_count
fields.doc: Current approval count when validation applies.

fields.name: reject_count
fields.doc: Current rejection count when validation applies.

fields.name: validator_count
fields.doc: Validator set size when validation applies.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Activity kind for display grouping.

fields.name: required_approvals
fields.doc: Approval count required for this activity.

fields.name: required_rejections
fields.doc: Rejection count that would fail this activity.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Amount posted by the underlying movement represented by this activity, in
 18-decimal unified asset units. This may be a net movement amount for
 fee-bearing fulfillment activity.

fields.name: ledger_transfer_id
fields.doc: Ledger transfer identifier for ledger-sourced settlement activities.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowStepView
types.doc:
FlowStepView is one factual observed visible step in the lifecycle detail
 view. Use `FlowSummaryView.progress_timeline` for the current projected
 progress state.

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: One-based observed step sequence for display and audit.

fields.name: step
fields.doc: Business-facing observed step.

fields.name: asset_ids
fields.doc: Asset identifiers involved in this step.

fields.name: polyester_chain_id
fields.doc: Polyester Chain id associated with this step when known.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Amount represented by this step in 18-decimal unified asset units. Steps
 may carry the actual net movement amount when fees have already been taken.

fields.name: request_fee
fields.doc: Request-scoped fee details when a fee applies to this step.

fields.name: milestone_tx_ref
fields.doc: Transaction reference most relevant to this step.

fields.name: lifecycle_source
fields.doc: Source that produced this visible step.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.doc: Product-facing reason for failed, dropped, or otherwise notable steps.

fields.name: current_confirmations
fields.doc: Current source confirmation count when confirmations apply.

fields.name: required_confirmations
fields.doc: Required source confirmation count when confirmations apply.

fields.name: approve_count
fields.doc: Current approval count when validation applies.

fields.name: reject_count
fields.doc: Current rejection count when validation applies.

fields.name: validator_count
fields.doc: Validator set size when validation applies.

fields.name: required_approvals
fields.doc: Approval count required for this validation step.

fields.name: required_rejections
fields.doc: Rejection count that would fail this validation step.

fields.name: occurred_at_unix_ms
fields.doc: Step occurrence timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: block_time_moving_average_ms
fields.doc: Source-chain block time moving average in milliseconds when known.

fields.name: activities
fields.doc:
Nested activity rows for expandable UI detail. The top-level step remains
 one visible lifecycle stage while activities expose the underlying on-chain
 evidence that advanced it.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowSummaryProgressView
types.doc: FlowSummaryProgressView describes progress within the current visible step.

fields.name: current_step_started_at_unix_ms
fields.doc:
Timestamp when the current visible step started, in milliseconds since epoch
 (UTC).

fields.name: current_step_expected_duration_ms
fields.doc: Expected duration for the current visible step in milliseconds.

fields.name: current_confirmations
fields.doc: Current source confirmation count when confirmations apply.

fields.name: required_confirmations
fields.doc: Required source confirmation count when confirmations apply.

fields.name: approve_count
fields.doc: Current approval count when validation applies.

fields.name: reject_count
fields.doc: Current rejection count when validation applies.

fields.name: validator_count
fields.doc: Validator set size when validation applies.

fields.name: required_approvals
fields.doc: Approval count required for the current validation step.

fields.name: required_rejections
fields.doc: Rejection count that would fail the current validation step.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowSummaryView
types.doc:
FlowSummaryView is the compact lifecycle representation used by lists,
 realtime updates, and the header of a detail view.

fields.name: owner_account_id
fields.doc: Public account identifier for the root account or subaccount the flow belongs to.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Smart-account address for the account the flow belongs to. This is the
 stable address selector equivalent of `owner_account_id`; do not derive it
 from source or destination display addresses.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc: Public, URL-safe lifecycle identifier for display, URLs, and user search.

fields.name: flow_kind
fields.doc: Product flow family.

fields.name: current_step
fields.doc:
Current user-facing progress step for this flow. This may be derived from
 the flow state before a matching factual observed step exists.

fields.name: asset_ids
fields.doc: Asset identifiers involved in the flow.

fields.name: polyester_chain_id
fields.doc: Polyester Chain id associated with this flow when known.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Gross principal amount for the flow in 18-decimal unified asset units.
 Request fees are exposed separately in request_fee. Specific fulfillment
 steps may carry a net movement amount when the step represents external
 delivery.

fields.name: request_fee
fields.doc:
Request-scoped fee details when a fee applies and should be visible for the
 current step.

fields.name: source_tx_hash
fields.doc: First observed source transaction hash for the flow when known.

fields.name: tx_occurrence_index
fields.doc:
Stable occurrence discriminator within a transaction. For source-chain
 deposits this is the batched leg index; for on-chain facts it is the log or
 equivalent per-tx occurrence index when available.

fields.name: source_address
fields.doc:
Source address to show for the overall flow. For internal transfers this is
 the source smart account address.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Destination address to show for the overall flow. For internal transfers
 this is the destination smart account address.

fields.name: latest_tx_ref
fields.doc: Latest transaction reference associated with the current visible state.

fields.name: source_domain
fields.doc:
Product domain where the overall flow starts. Use with
 `destination_domain` for route labels such as Funding to Trading.

fields.name: destination_domain
fields.doc:
Product domain where the overall flow ends or currently settles. Do not
 derive route labels from per-step settlement activity.

fields.name: latest_lifecycle_source
fields.doc:
Provenance of the latest meaningful lifecycle activity reflected in this
 summary. This is not necessarily the source of the entire flow.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.doc: Product-facing reason for failed, dropped, or otherwise notable flows.

fields.name: started_at_unix_ms
fields.doc: First observed business timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: updated_at_unix_ms
fields.doc: Last summary update timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: terminal_at_unix_ms
fields.doc: Terminal timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC), or zero while open.

fields.name: last_activity_at_unix_ms
fields.doc: Timestamp used for list ordering in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: is_open
fields.doc: True when the flow is still progressing.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc: True when the flow reached a final state.

fields.name: current_step_sequence
fields.doc: One-based sequence of `current_step` in `progress_timeline`.

fields.name: current_progress
fields.doc: Progress data for the current visible step when the flow is open.

fields.name: progress_timeline
fields.doc:
Progress-bar timeline for list/header UI. This timeline may include a
 current derived step that is ahead of the latest factual observed step.

fields.name: estimated_completion_unix_ms
fields.doc: Estimated Unix completion timestamp in milliseconds.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowTimelineItemView
types.doc:
FlowTimelineItemView is one item in the expected visible lifecycle progress
 path.

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: One-based sequence within the expected timeline.

fields.name: step
fields.doc: Visible lifecycle step.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Progress status for this timeline item.

fields.name: expected_duration_ms
fields.doc:
Expected duration of this visible step in milliseconds, derived from recent
 observed timing data for the same flow type.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowTimelineStatus
types.doc:
FlowTimelineStatus describes how a progress timeline item relates to the
 current user-facing flow state.

values.name: TIMELINE_STATUS_COMPLETED
values.doc: Step has been observed or is behind the current progress step.

values.name: TIMELINE_STATUS_CURRENT
values.doc: Step is the current active progress step.

values.name: TIMELINE_STATUS_PLANNED
values.doc: Step is expected but has not been observed yet.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.FlowTxMatchView
types.doc: FlowTxMatchView is one lifecycle flow matched by a transaction-hash search.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc: Public, URL-safe lifecycle identifier for display, URLs, and user search.

fields.name: flow_kind
fields.doc: Product flow family.

fields.name: source_tx_hash
fields.doc: First observed source transaction hash for the flow when known.

fields.name: latest_tx_ref
fields.doc: Latest transaction reference associated with the current visible state.

fields.name: tx_occurrence_index
fields.doc:
Stable occurrence discriminator within a transaction. For source-chain
 deposits this is the batched leg index; for on-chain facts it is the log or
 equivalent per-tx occurrence index when available.

fields.name: source_domain
fields.doc: Product domain where the overall flow starts.

fields.name: destination_domain
fields.doc: Product domain where the overall flow ends or currently settles.

fields.name: current_step
fields.doc: Current user-facing progress step for this flow.

fields.name: is_open
fields.doc: True when this flow is still progressing.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc: True when this flow reached a final state.

fields.name: asset_ids
fields.doc: Asset identifiers involved in this flow.

fields.name: polyester_chain_id
fields.doc: Polyester Chain id associated with this flow.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Gross principal amount for this flow in 18-decimal unified asset units.

fields.name: source_address
fields.doc: Source address to show for this flow.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Destination address to show for this flow.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.doc: Product-facing reason for failed, dropped, or otherwise notable flows.

fields.name: last_activity_at_unix_ms
fields.doc: Timestamp used for list ordering in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.GetFlowByIdRequest
types.doc: GetFlowByIdRequest selects one lifecycle flow by its public flow id.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc: Public, URL-safe lifecycle identifier returned by list/search responses.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.GetFlowResponse
types.doc:
GetFlowResponse returns one lifecycle flow with summary, factual steps, and
 estimated timeline data when available.

fields.name: flow
fields.doc: Lifecycle flow detail for the requested intent id.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.LifecycleSource
types.doc:
LifecycleSource identifies the subsystem that emitted a normalized fact or
 visible milestone.

values.name: SOURCE_RELAYER
values.doc: Off-chain relayer or source-chain watcher.

values.name: SOURCE_POLYESTER_CHAIN
values.doc: Polyester Chain contract event or other chain-owned lifecycle fact.

values.name: SOURCE_EXECUTOR
values.doc: Executor-owned lifecycle fact.

values.name: SOURCE_LEDGER
values.doc: Off-chain ledger posting or settlement fact.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.ListFlowsByTxRequest
types.doc:
ListFlowsByTxRequest searches lifecycle flows by transaction identifier. A
 single chain transaction can map to zero, one, or many lifecycle flows.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc:
Chain transaction identifier to search for. Accepts a 0x-prefixed 32-byte
 EVM hash or a printable chain-native transaction id such as a Solana
 signature, Bitcoin txid, Litecoin txid, Dogecoin txid, or XRP transaction
 hash.

fields.name: lookup_kind
fields.doc: Lookup mode that determines which transaction references are searched.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted; maximum
 is 500.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor returned by a previous response. The cursor is
 exclusive and bound to the transaction hash and lookup mode.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.ListFlowsByTxResponse
types.doc:
ListFlowsByTxResponse returns a page of lifecycle flows that reference one
 transaction hash.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc: Transaction hash searched by the request.

fields.name: matches
fields.doc:
Matching flows ordered by tx occurrence, flow kind, domains, activity time,
 and stable identifiers.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.ListFlowsRequest
types.doc: ListFlowsRequest filters and paginates lifecycle flow summaries.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of flows to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted; maximum is
 500.

fields.name: sort
fields.doc: Sort direction for the selected ordering timestamp.

fields.name: flow_kind
fields.doc: Optional product flow kind filter. Unspecified includes all kinds.

fields.name: flow_state
fields.doc:
Optional lifecycle state filter. Unspecified includes all states permitted
 by the selected scope.

fields.name: tx_ref
fields.doc:
Optional transaction reference filter. Matches source or latest activity
 transaction identifiers across supported chains.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Selects open, terminal, or all lifecycle flows.

fields.name: owner_account_id
fields.doc: Public account identifier for a main account or subaccount.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart account address on Polyester Chain.

fields.name: polyester_chain_ids
fields.doc: Optional Polyester Chain ids to include. Maximum 100 unique ids.

fields.name: zipped_asset_ids
fields.doc: Optional chain asset mapping ids to include. Maximum 100 unique ids.

fields.name: unified_asset_ids
fields.doc: Optional unified asset ids to include. Maximum 100 unique ids.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor returned by a previous response. The cursor is
 exclusive and bound to the caller, filters, account selector, sort
 direction, and ordering timestamp.

fields.name: order_by
fields.doc: Timestamp used for ordering and pagination. Defaults to last activity.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.ListFlowsResponse
types.doc: ListFlowsResponse returns one page of flow summaries.

fields.name: flows
fields.doc:
Flow summaries ordered by the selected timestamp, then public flow id. Sort
 direction is controlled by the request `sort` field.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.ListOrderBy
types.doc: ListOrderBy selects which timestamp ListFlows uses for ordering and cursors.

values.name: ORDER_BY_LAST_ACTIVITY
values.doc: Order by the latest lifecycle activity timestamp.

values.name: ORDER_BY_STARTED_AT
values.doc:
Order by the first observed business timestamp. Rows without a start time
 use their terminal timestamp when available.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.ListScope
types.doc: ListScope selects which lifecycle state bucket should be returned.

values.name: LIST_ALL
values.doc: Include both open and terminal flows.

values.name: LIST_OPEN_ONLY
values.doc: Include only flows that are still progressing.

values.name: LIST_TERMINAL_ONLY
values.doc: Include only flows that reached a terminal state.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.RequestFee
types.doc:
RequestFee captures the on-chain fee associated with a deposit or withdrawal
 request. This is separate from summary `amount_e18`, which carries the gross
 request principal for API display.

fields.name: asset_ids
fields.doc: Asset identities for the fee asset.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
On-chain request fee in 18-decimal units of the fee asset identified by
 asset_ids. Separate from gross flow amount_e18 on summaries.

fields.name: recipient_address
fields.doc: Fee recipient address when settled on chain.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current state of the fee snapshot.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.RequestFeeStatus
types.doc:
RequestFeeStatus identifies the current lifecycle state of a request-scoped
 on-chain fee snapshot.

values.name: REQUEST_FEE_STATUS_LOCKED
values.doc: The request locked a fee snapshot at creation time.

values.name: REQUEST_FEE_STATUS_SETTLED
values.doc: The request completed far enough for the locked fee to settle.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.Sort
types.doc: Sort selects lifecycle list direction.

values.name: SORT_NEWEST
values.doc: Return newest rows first for the selected ordering timestamp.

values.name: SORT_OLDEST
values.doc: Return oldest rows first for the selected ordering timestamp.

types.name: chain.lifecycle.v1.TxLookupKind
types.doc: TxLookupKind controls which transaction reference fields are searched.

values.name: TX_SOURCE
values.doc: Match only the original source transaction hash for a flow.

values.name: TX_ANY
values.doc:
Match either the source transaction hash or the latest known activity
 transaction reference.
